name: Customer
description: An individual end-user of a NorthLake bank client whose data NorthLake processes on the bank's behalf.

name: Bank Client
description: A banking institution that embeds NorthLake's APIs and on whose behalf NorthLake processes data.

name: Account
description: A financial account held by a customer at a bank client (checking

name: Transaction
description: A single payment or money-movement event associated with an account.

name: Cardholder Data
description: Data elements defined by PCI DSS, including the Primary Account Number (PAN), cardholder name, and expiry.

name: Lending Application
description: A customer's application for credit processed by the LendLens product.

name: Credit Score
description: A numeric assessment (300-850) of a customer's creditworthiness used in lending decisions.

name: Annual Income
description: Self-reported or verified yearly income used in lending decisions.

name: PII
description: Information that identifies or can identify a specific individual, alone or combined.

name: Sensitive PII
description: PII that, if disclosed, creates significant harm risk (e.g., SSN, date of birth).

name: Financial Data
description: Data describing a customer's financial position or activity (balances, amounts, income).

name: Restricted Data
description: Highest classification: PII, sensitive financial data, cardholder data, and secrets. Strict access control and encryption required.

name: Confidential Data
description: Sensitive business or financial data whose disclosure would harm NorthLake or a client, but not regulated PII.

name: Internal Data
description: Operational data intended for internal use; low harm if disclosed.

name: Public Data
description: Data approved for public release; no restriction.

name: Data Owner
description: Accountable executive/role for a data domain; approves access and classification.

name: Data Steward
description: Operational role responsible for day-to-day data quality and definitions within a domain.

name: Data Custodian
synonyms: Platform/SRE) that implements storage and controls for the data.
